title: Tech Note: [3rd Party Tech Note] Sending HTML Emails
author: Dave Terry, Pacific Data Management, Inc.
featured_technology: MIME multipart HTML email with inline (cid:) image attachments
Regex-based HTML image tag rewriting (Match regex)
4D Web Area preview of outgoing HTML

historical_commentary.text: The core technique — rewriting HTML image tags to cid: references and attaching the corresponding images via MIME so that HTML emails render reliably and portably — reflects standard email engineering practice that has not fundamentally changed since 2014, and 4D Internet Commands (4DIC) remains 4D's supported plug-in for SMTP-based email sending. The specific 4D code (regex-based tag rewriting, SMTP_ command calls) is dated in style but functionally still valid; a modern implementation might lean on newer 4D JSON/text commands for cleaner string handling, but no replacement plug-in has superseded 4DIC's email-sending role.
